facts.text: CVG’s parking page says payments require credit cards and cash is not accepted. This does not establish an alternative payment or assistance procedure.
facts.quote: Please note that we exclusively accept credit cards and do not accept cash as a form of payment.

facts.text: CVG lists continuous pickup/drop-off and luggage assistance at ValuPark. For the Economy Lot, pickup/drop-off is at shelters, with shuttles listed every 15 minutes. These are airport service descriptions, not guaranteed waits or a device-fit assessment.
facts.quote: CVG ValuPark: $12/day 24/7 Continuous Vehicle Pickup/Drop-off / Luggage assistance Map of CVG ValuPark CVG Economy Lot: $10/day Lowest cost on-airport option. 24/7 Pickup/Drop-off at Shelters. Shuttles run every 15 minutes

facts.text: BusGenius offers real-time shuttle tracking for CVG Economy Lot and ValuPark. This does not establish the route from a particular bay or shelter to the vehicle.
facts.quote: BusGenius provides real-time shuttle tracking for our CVG Economy Lot and CVG ValuPark.

facts.text: CVG’s accessible-transport list names Executive Transportation (859-261-8841), Express Mobile ADA (859-655-4600), Ride A WAV Cincy (859-918-9900) and zTrip (513-962-1122). The airport recommends scheduling directly ahead of time; confirm vehicle fit, boarding help and the meeting point.
facts.quote: Accessible Ground Transportation We have multiple Authorized Operators who offer ADA transportation for your convenience. We highly recommend contacting the business ahead of time to schedule. ADA Authorized Operators Number Executive Transportation 859-261-8841 Express Mobile ADA 859-655-4600 Ride A WAV Cincy 859-918-9900 zTrip 513-962-1122

facts.text: Rideshare and taxi instructions point to Ground Transport East on Baggage Claim level; hotel shuttles use Ground Transport West. Most authorized providers collect at these areas, separate from the Terminal curbfront. Confirm the selected operator’s pickup point and the route to it.
facts.quote: Most of the below providers will be available from either Ground Transport East or Ground Transport West . This is not located at the Terminal curbfront.

facts.text: CVG says GoodMaps supports multiple languages and tactile cues for silent indoor navigation. This app feature is not a quiet-room designation or a live check of route conditions.
facts.quote: GoodMaps supports multiple languages and includes tactile cues for silent navigation, ensuring a welcoming and inclusive experience for guests from around the world.

facts.text: Terminal entrances have curb ramps; elevators serve the garage, terminal and both concourses.
facts.quote: All entrances have accessible ramps from curb to the Terminal, and all facilities have elevators. Passengers can be met curbside, at baggage claim, or at the Meeting Point on the lower level. Only ticketed passengers with boarding passes are allowed beyond the security checkpoint. If a passenger with a disability requires assistance to/from the gate or medical equipment such as oxygen at the gate, a pass provided by the airline must be shown at the security checkpoint. Distance The distance from the departure level sidewalk to the ticket counter is approximately 175 feet. Accessible ramps are available to the terminal. View terminal layouts including the location of restrooms and animal relief areas, or get Step-by-Step Directions to and from your gate. Elevators Elevators are available in the garage, Terminal and both Concourses.

facts.text: Family-assist restrooms are near Gates A11, B11 and B13, after security. CVG lists an adult changing table in the B13 family-assist restroom; dimensions and transfer arrangements are not supplied.
facts.quote: Family assist restrooms are located near Gates A-11, B-11, and B-13 (after security). There is an adult changing table in the family assist restroom at B-13.

facts.text: The airport lists a sensory space, ASL announcement translations and blind/low-vision navigation services.
facts.quote: Blind & Low Vision Services Aira An app providing professional visual interpreters. Learn more GoodMaps Maps designed to assist blind and low vision individuals. Learn more Deaf & Hearing Loss Services Signapse ASL translations of audio announcements in the airport. Learn more Aira ASL Connect with a professional sign language interpreter via video call. Learn more ASL Interpretation Services Request in-person ASL interpretation services by reaching out to info@cvgairport.com. Service Animals Service Animals Service animals are allowed throughout the airport in accordance with and as defined by Title II and Title III of the ADA. Learn more SARAs Service animal relief areas (SARA) are located in Concourse A and B, near gate A18 and gate B13. Learn more Neurodivergent Services HD Sunflower Lanyard Program The Sunflower Lanyard Program allows travelers with hidden disabilities to discreetly indicate that they may need additional assistance. Learn more Sensory Space Designed to help travelers who are neurodivergent and need a place to recenter.

facts.text: Familiarization tours and step-by-step airport directions are available.
facts.quote: Familiarization Tours These tours provide a first-hand experience through the airport journey.

facts.text: The Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program lets travelers discreetly indicate that they may need additional assistance.
facts.quote: The Sunflower Lanyard Program allows travelers with hidden disabilities to discreetly indicate that they may need additional assistance.

facts.text: Arrange free wheelchair assistance with your airline before travel. At the airport, Bags, Inc. offers free assistance from the first floor of the Rental Car Center; call 1-513-607-3218. CVG says an attendant can meet you at any level of the Rental Car Center within the Terminal building.
facts.quote: Please contact your airline in advance of your travel to schedule wheelchair assistance at no additional charge. Contact information for each airline can be found below. How do I order a wheelchair once at the airport? Upon arrival at the airport, wheelchair assistance may be requested at no additional charge through Bags, Inc. Located on the first floor of the Rental Car Center, Bags, Inc. can be contacted by calling 1-513-607-3218. An attendant will meet you with a wheelchair at any level of the Rental Car Center within the Terminal building.

facts.text: A companion helping a passenger with a disability to or from the gate needs an airline-issued pass to show at the security checkpoint.
facts.quote: If a passenger with a disability requires assistance to/from the gate or medical equipment such as oxygen at the gate, a pass provided by the airline must be shown at the security checkpoint.

facts.text: It is about 175 feet from the departure-level sidewalk to the ticket counter. The free ValuPark lot shuttle is wheelchair accessible.
facts.quote: The distance from the departure level sidewalk to the ticket counter is approximately 175 feet. Accessible ramps are available to the terminal. View terminal layouts including the location of restrooms and animal relief areas, or get Step-by-Step Directions to and from your gate. Elevators Elevators are available in the garage, Terminal and both Concourses. All elevators are equipped with emergency call buttons, Braille signage and raised numbers. Luggage Carts Carts are located in the CVG Terminal Garage and at the Terminal on both the ticketing and baggage claim levels for free. There are carts located at the Ground Transport West drop off / pick up location for all parking shuttles and hotel shuttles. Restrooms Restrooms accessible to individuals with disabilities are located in the Terminal and both Concourses. Family assist restrooms are located near Gates A-11, B-11, and B-13 (after security). There is an adult changing table in the family assist restroom at B-13. Emergency Info In case of emergency, audio visual fire alarms and automated external defibrillators are available throughout the airport. Information Booths Information booths are located in the Terminal and in both concourses. All locations have access to language interpreters, including American Sign Language. Parking All parking facilities offer handicapped spaces. The CVG Terminal Garage offers accessible routes equipped with curb ramps. The CVG ValuPark Lot operates a free shuttle bus that is wheelchair accessible.

facts.text: Indoor service-animal relief areas are near Gates A18 and B13. The outdoor area is on Baggage Claim level near Ground Transportation Center East. Departing passengers using the outdoor area must return through the security checkpoint before their flight.
facts.quote: The indoor relief area is centrally located in Concourse A, near gate A18 and Concourse B, near gate B13. The outdoor relief area is located on the Baggage Claim level near the Ground Transportation Center East. Customers using the outdoor location will be required to return through the Security Checkpoint before departing on a flight.

facts.text: Monitors throughout the terminals show public-address announcements visually.
facts.quote: The Airport has monitors throughout the terminals that visually convey information broadcast over the public address system.

facts.text: The sensory room announced for children is in Concourse A next to the Over the Rhine Market, diagonal from Starbucks.
facts.quote: The room is located next to the Over the Rhine Market in Concourse A and diagonal from Starbucks.

facts.text: TSA Cares (1-855-787-2227) helps travelers with disabilities and medical conditions through screening; CVG suggests calling about 72 hours before travel.
facts.quote: TSA Cares is a helpline that provides travelers with disabilities, medical conditions and other special circumstances additional assistance during the security screening process. Call TSA Cares at 1-855-787-2227 hours prior to traveling with questions about screening policies, procedures and what to expect at the security checkpoint. To help expedite your passage through security, and for information on what items are allowed on the aircraft, visit the TSA online or call 1-855-787-2227. It is best to call approximately 72 hours ahead of travel.

facts.text: For departures into either concourse, CVG’s directions place the elevator between the escalators when you face them from the Transportation Tunnel.
facts.quote: When facing the escalators, stay to your right for the up escalator or proceed between the escalators for the elevator.

facts.text: When exiting the Transportation Tunnel into the public Terminal area, CVG’s directions put the elevator to all Terminal levels in the center; the Ticketing escalators are to the left.
facts.quote: Upon exiting, to your left are escalators to and from the Ticketing level. Proceed down the center for the elevator to all Terminal levels.

facts.text: CVG gives the Terminal–Concourse B distance as less than 1,500 feet, with typical travel times of four minutes by train or six minutes walking. These are airport estimates, rather than individual walking-time guarantees.
facts.quote: The furthest distance between the Terminal and Concourse B is less than 1,500 feet. Typical travel time between the Terminal and Concourse B is 4 minutes by train or 6 minutes by walking.

facts.text: The children’s sensory-room description includes a wall that plays animal sounds or music when touched and another that lights up. It also lists soft furniture, a rocker and a small soft hide-out.
facts.quote: Soft furniture and squeezy chairs Furniture in the sensory room invite children to plop down and relax. Therapy rocker The therapy rocker providers gentle movement for children. Interactive walls One wall plays animal sounds or music as a child places their hand on the wall. The other wall lights up with interesting and calming colors. Bubble tube The green bubble tube provides children with the opportunity to focus on visual movement. Small house This small, soft house is for kids who need their own hide-out before or after a busy flight.

facts.text: CVG says all airport elevators have emergency call buttons, Braille signs and raised numbers.
facts.quote: All elevators are equipped with emergency call buttons, Braille signage and raised numbers.

facts.text: To request in-person ASL interpretation at CVG, email info@cvgairport.com. The accessibility page does not give a notice period for this service.
facts.quote: Request in-person ASL interpretation services by reaching out to info@cvgairport.com.

facts.text: Pick up a Sunflower lanyard at the information booth in Terminal Baggage Claim. CVG also lists info@cvgairport.com or 859-767-3230 to arrange collection or request that a lanyard be sent to your residence.
facts.quote: Pick up a Hidden Disabilities Sunflower item at these locations: Information Booth at the Terminal Baggage Claim Contacting info@cvgairport.com or calling (859) 767-3230 to pick up a lanyard or to request one be sent to your residence.

facts.text: CVG says a Sunflower lanyard indicates that someone may need extra assistance or time; it does not give access to expedited security screening or other benefits.
facts.quote: The Hidden Disabilities Sunflower does not entitle the wearer to anything other than identifying that you have a hidden disability and that you may need some assistance, help, or a little more time. It is not a pass to be fast-tracked through security, nor for any other benefit.

additionalSupport.quote: Follow signage to Ground Transport East on the Baggage Claim level.
Taxicab Service Follow signage to Ground Transport East on the Baggage Claim level.
Hotel Courtesy Shuttles Follow signs for Ground Transport West for all hotel shuttles.
